# Rowan University Sites

> Rowan University's institutional hub featuring the Virtua Health College of Medicine & Life Sciences, clinical education programs, and cultural institutions.

This site aggregates key academic and medical programs at Rowan University in South Jersey, including partnerships with Virtua Health for medical education, continuing professional development, and community cultural resources. The platform serves as a central directory for healthcare professionals, students, and the public seeking information about Rowan's medical, nursing, and life sciences initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Virtua Health College of Medicine & Life Sciences
- Rowan Medicine
- Medical Education
- Healthcare Professions
- Clinical Research
- Continuing Medical Education (CME)
- Nursing Programs
- Opioid Safety
- Academic Detailing
- Rowan-Virtua Partnership
- Academic Medicine
- South Jersey
- Museum of Contemporary Art
- Grand Rounds
- Professional Development

## Medical Education & Training

- [Virtua Health College of Medicine & Life Sciences](https://sites.rowan.edu/vhc/index.html): Homepage for Virtua Health College of Medicine & Life Sciences at Rowan University
- [Academic Detailing Program](https://sites.rowan.edu/academic-detailing): Academic detailing program on opioid safety and prescribing for healthcare professionals

## Arts & Culture

- [Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art](https://sites.rowan.edu/artgallery): Rowan University Museum of Contemporary Art exhibitions and visitor information
